reasoning: Shows a simplified 3D rectangular hardware enclosure with a single front indicator LED, standard for an external hard drive, disk drive, mini PC, or set-top box. It fits computer storage, backup, and home media box tasks well, though its minimal shape can be confused with a single drawer or generic box at small sizes.
